source_caption:
Fernanda Torres was only 20 years old when she delivered this devastating, feature-length acting masterclass. Carrying an intense, claustrophobic emotional sparring match almost entirely on her shoulders, her raw vulnerability won her the prestigious Best Actress award at the Cannes Film Festival, cementing her as a global cinematic powerhouse.
⠀
Love Me Forever or Never (1986), directed by Arnaldo Jabor, starring Fernanda Torres, Thales Pan Chacon. A recently separated young couple reunites for a grueling, deeply intimate psychoanalytic confrontation to dissect their shattered relationship and lingering desires.

source_details.title: Love Me Forever or Never
source_details.synopsis: Love Me Forever or Never (Portuguese: Eu Sei que Vou Te Amar) is a 1986 Brazilian drama film directed by Arnaldo Jabor. The film stars Fernanda Torres and Thales Pan Chacon. The film screened at Cannes Festival, where it was selected for the main exhibition, competing for the Palme d'Or for Best Film. Fernanda Torres received the Prix d'interprétation féminine, becoming the first Brazilian actress to win the prize. It was commercially released on April 17, 1986.
